newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mixed in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mixed in quiet trade.

text.p: U.S. millfeed prices were mixed, buffeted by lackluster demand and supported by shortened run times, dealers said.
Dealers also said activity for the most part, was quiet.

"Springtime is here and demand has really fallen off. But there is not much activity going on," a Kansas dealer said, noting that livestock is beginning to feed on pasture in Oklahoma, Kansas and Texas.
Flour mill runtimes will be reduced because of the (Easter) holiday next week. But demand has slacked off more than the reduction in run times, he added.
"The only thing holding this market up are reduced run times in flour mills and merchandisers trying to cover their shorts," a Carolinas dealer said.
He noted more substitutions like soy hulls and hominy were working their way into the market.
